user_problem: A supplied sampling frame needs a bounded description of included and excluded populations without claiming representativeness.
unique_output: A coverage note listing frame rules, observable exclusions, duplicate risks, time bounds, and unknown coverage.
required_input: Target population definition, frame construction rules, dated frame summary, and known exclusion notes.
critical_rule: Never claim representativeness or bias magnitude; report only rule-based coverage and supplied limitations.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is taxonomy-gap-finder; this assesses population-frame coverage rather than taxonomy assignment coverage.
acceptance_scenario: Input target is all 2026 workshop attendees; frame contains online registrants and excludes walk-ins; duplicates may arise from changed emails. Output states the inclusion, exclusion, duplicate risk, and that total walk-in coverage is unknown.
